verdicts.evidence: An AST-based audit of the released code found 19 registered tools, 8 skill documents, all 8 benchmark stage modules present, and a Claude Agent SDK streaming loop with a stepwise tool-use system prompt, but the pipeline was never executed end-to-end, the ReAct loop is delegated to the SDK rather than locally implemented, and the 'first' priority claim was not evaluated.

No benchmark execution was performed; the logbook reports that the original model (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) is retired, the 306 traces/predictions are not released, and no automatic success judge exists in the repository. Only source-token concordance (finding '\textbf{68.9}' in .tex files) was checked, which the logbook itself states is not reproduction evidence.

An independent JSONL parser executed on sp_bench.jsonl found 102 records with 102 unique IDs and 102 unique queries, recomputed 18 categories and 8 stages, and produced tier counts {advanced:21, basic:40, challenging:13, intermediate:28} matching the claimed split exactly.

No CRC-CODEX evaluation was run; the logbook states the official dataset lacks the evaluation inputs, generated quantification outputs, and complete ground-truth bundle needed to recompute the reported 0.953/0.902/0.368 values. Only source-token concordance was checked.

Ground-truth files (2,013,525 rows) passed structural schema checks, but original agent predictions are absent, so the reported 0.681 average similarity cannot be recomputed. The logbook also identified evaluator issues (row-order sensitivity, repeated cellLabel values in one ground-truth file) but did not execute any annotation evaluation.

overall: The logbook independently verifies the structural composition of SP-Bench (102 queries, 18 categories, 8 stages, correct tier split) and partially confirms the agent's code architecture (19 tools, 8 stage modules, Claude Agent SDK loop) through static AST/JSONL analysis. All three numerical performance claims (SP-Bench accuracy, CRC-CODEX metrics, cell-annotation similarity) remain unreproduced because original traces, predictions, and evaluation inputs are missing and no agent execution was attempted.
